description: Everyday notes that no case expects, so that a rank means something. Some share words or tags with a case by chance; none is the answer to one.

fragments.title: Winter tyres on
fragments.body: Swapped to studded tyres at the garage on Hämeentie. Next check in April.

fragments.title: Renew passport
fragments.body: The photo booth at the station takes cards only.

fragments.title: Book: The Overstory
fragments.body: Halfway through. The early chapters, one per character and their tree, are the best part.

fragments.title: Fixing the dripping bathroom tap
fragments.body: The washer was worn flat. Took the old one to the hardware store to match the size.

fragments.title: Shared tool library for the building
fragments.body: A shelf in the basement storage where neighbours lend drills, ladders and a pressure washer.

fragments.title: Planted the raised bed
fragments.body: Two rows of carrots, radishes along the edge, marigolds at the corners.

fragments.title: Midsummer at the cottage
fragments.body: The lake was still cold. Next year bring the bigger tarp for the rain.

fragments.title: Bank card fraud alert
fragments.body: The bank called about a charge from an online shop I never used. Card cancelled; a new one is in the post.

fragments.title: Move the team wiki to Markdown in git
fragments.body: Pages were going stale in the old wiki. Markdown next to the code gets reviewed with the code.

fragments.title: Pumpkin soup
fragments.body: Roast the pumpkin first, then blend with ginger and coconut milk. Freezes well.

fragments.title: Joulukortit
fragments.body: Lähetä kortit mummolle ja Ainolle viimeistään kymmenentenä päivänä.

fragments.title: Electricity contract
fragments.body: Switched to a spot-price contract. Compare the monthly bill against the fixed price in March.

fragments.title: Code review etiquette
fragments.body: Comment on the diff, not the person. Ask questions instead of giving orders when unsure.

fragments.title: Volunteer rota for the spring fair
fragments.body: Two people per stall shift. Sign up in the shared spreadsheet; Marja coordinates the cake table.

fragments.title: Dentist appointment
fragments.body: Call to move the check-up; the 18th clashes with the offsite.

fragments.title: Rhubarb is up
fragments.body: First stalks ready. Leave the plant alone in its first year next time we divide it.

fragments.title: Meeting room booking is broken
fragments.body: The calendar shows the big room free when it isn't. Two teams turned up at once today.

fragments.title: Mökin laituri
fragments.body: Laiturin lankut lahoavat rannan päästä. Uudet lankut painekyllästetystä puusta ensi kesänä.

fragments.title: Batch cooking on Sundays
fragments.body: Two big pots, a curry and a chili, portioned into the freezer cover most weekday lunches.

fragments.title: Phone battery replaced
fragments.body: Battery health was down to 71%. The repair shop swapped it in an hour; it holds a full day again.

fragments.title: Pikkujoulut
fragments.body: Firman pikkujoulut ravintolassa. Ruoka oli hyvää, musiikki liian kovalla.

fragments.title: Year in review
fragments.body: Read 19 books, did two half marathons, and finally fixed the bathroom tap for good.

fragments.title: Leap day lunch
fragments.body: Tried the new Vietnamese place by the station. The pho was great, the spring rolls soggy.

fragments.title: On-call rotation: one week each
fragments.body: Shorter shifts were handed over too often and context got lost. A week each, swapped by agreement.

fragments.title: Compost too wet
fragments.body: Smells sour. Mixed in shredded cardboard and turned it; better after a week.

fragments.title: Kirjastokortti
fragments.body: Uusi kirjastokortti tilattu, vanha katosi bussissa.

fragments.title: Ferry to Tallinn
fragments.body: Day trip with the kids. Book the morning ferry early; the afternoon ones fill up in July.

fragments.title: Wasp nest under the eaves
fragments.body: Pest control came on Tuesday. Don't leave sweet drinks outside in August.

fragments.title: Weekly planning on Friday afternoon
fragments.body: Pick next week's three most important things before logging off, not on Monday.

fragments.title: Sauna stove stones
fragments.body: Replace the stones every couple of years; cracked ones crumble and block the airflow.

fragments.title: Winter tyres
fragments.body: Book the tyre change before the first frost.

fragments.title: Gift ideas
fragments.body: Aino: climbing shoes, size 38. Dad: a good bread knife.

fragments.title: Hiihtoladut auki
fragments.body: Keskuspuiston ladut on ajettu. Sukset voitelematta, pito huono.

fragments.title: Standing desk
fragments.body: Alternating every hour helps the back more than standing all day.

fragments.title: Seed order
fragments.body: Ordered tomato, chili and pea seeds. Sow the tomatoes indoors mid-March.

fragments.title: Bike service
fragments.body: Annual service at the shop: new brake pads and a chain.

fragments.title: Five-a-side moved
fragments.body: The pitch at the school is being resurfaced, so games move to Thursday at the sports hall.

fragments.title: Juhannus
fragments.body: Mökillä satoi koko viikonlopun. Lautapelit pelastivat.

fragments.title: Retire the old build server
fragments.body: Everything builds in CI now; the machine under the desk only costs power.

fragments.title: Flu jab
fragments.body: Booked for next Thursday at the health centre.
